constraints: printSettings must have been generated by the Print settings to BLOB command.
The restored settings only take effect as long as no subsequent command (e.g. SET PRINT OPTION, or PRINT SELECTION without the '>' parameter) modifies them.
PRINT SELECTION, PRINT LABEL, and PRINT RECORD must be called with the '>' parameter for the settings applied by this command to be kept.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Restores the current 4D print settings from a BLOB previously produced by Print settings to BLOB, returning a status code indicating whether the load succeeded and whether the printer identity changed.
